page_title: ACM 1-0 UDI | AC Milan v Udinese 19/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+12' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Udinese.
90+9' After what seems an eternity, referee Daniele Chiffi decides there was an offside after using VAR to review the goal! NO GOAL for Udinese, play to continue.
90+7' The goal for Udinese is subject to a VAR review by the referee! He's obviously unsure or he received a message.
90+5' An unlucky rebound falls to Christian Kabasele (Udinese) and he scores with a bullet header.
90+4' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) sends a cross into the box, but Mike Maignan comes off his line to gather the ball.
90+2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for AC Milan.
90+2' The possession of the ball – 45:55.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.

90' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Udinese are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
89' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.
89' Mike Maignan (AC Milan) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
88' Substitution. Samuel Chukwueze is replaced by Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan).
86' The corner is swung in but Udinese can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
85' An attempted cross from Brenner (Udinese) is cleared. The linesman makes the right call and Udinese will have a corner.
83' AC Milan take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
83' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee signals a corner kick to AC Milan.
82' A yellow card for bad language! Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
81' Substitution. Jesper Karlstrom makes his way off the pitch and Brenner (Udinese) comes on as his replacement.
81' Jaka Bijol (Udinese) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post.
80' Udinese are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
78' Paulo Fonseca is forced to make a change. Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Ruben Loftus-Cheek.
76' The injury to Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
75' Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a sweet strike towards the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper, however, denies him with a stunning save.
75' A loose ball is pounced on by Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Maduka Okoye is alert and makes a comfortable save.
73' The substitution is prepared. Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Alvaro Morata.

72' What a chance for Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) as he produced a stunning snap shot from the edge of the box! The goalkeeper was a bit lucky as the ball goes inches over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
71' The corner kick from Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
71' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. AC Milan get a corner.
70' Kosta Runjaic has decided to make a change. Martin Payero (Udinese) replaces Sandi Lovric.
69' Substitution. Oier Zarraga did his best and is replaced by Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese).
67' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) serves up a nice cross, but Mike Maignan punches the ball away.
66' AC Milan exchange some quick one-two passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes in the blink of an eye.
64' 7:8 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.

61' Udinese slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
61' Here is a change. Kingsley Ehizibue is going off and Kosta Runjaic gives the last tactical orders to Hassane Kamara (Udinese).
61' Here comes a substitution. Iker Bravo is given a rest as he is replaced by Keinan Davis (Udinese).
57' Udinese failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
54' Udinese seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
52' Dangerous play by Isaak Toure (Udinese). Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul.
51' AC Milan enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
49' Filippo Terracciano (AC Milan) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
47' Great teamplay by Udinese as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Paulo Fonseca gives a chance to Yunus Musah and Noah Okafor (AC Milan) is off.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.

45+3' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. It will be a corner kick for AC Milan.

45+2' AC Milan slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
45+1' The goal by Udinese is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
45+1' Wait! Referee Daniele Chiffi immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
43' Jaka Bijol (Udinese) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
40' The referee blows his whistle as Sandi Lovric (Udinese) was too aggressive in his challenge.
38' Udinese are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
37' Noah Okafor (AC Milan) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
34' Jaka Bijol (Udinese) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Daniele Chiffi has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
34' The Udinese players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
33' Iker Bravo (Udinese) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
29' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) receives a red card for his foul. Looking at it again, it's a harsh red card.
28' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
27' Wonderful movement by Udinese. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
26' Udinese can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

25' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety. The ball goes out for a corner. Udinese can continue in their attacking effort.
25' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Udinese have been awarded a corner kick.
25' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
22' Udinese seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
20' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

18' Maduka Okoye pulls off a fantastic save! Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the top of the net, but the effort is kept out.
15' Udinese control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
13' 1 - 0 Goal Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan)! Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) was put through by Christian Pulisic and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
12' AC Milan have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

11' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat. AC Milan force their opponents to concede a corner.

10' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The referee blows his whistle, AC Milan are awarded a corner kick.
9' Noah Okafor (AC Milan) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his low effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.

6' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. AC Milan are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from AC Milan comes to nothing.
4' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Now AC Milan have a corner.
2' Neat passing move from AC Milan in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. AC Milan will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Daniele Chiffi.
